import math

int integer_value(string text)
    return int(text)

int floor_ratio(int numerator, int denominator)
    return if numerator >= 0 then numerator / denominator else -((-numerator + denominator - 1) / denominator)

int half_up(int numerator, int denominator)
    return floor_ratio(2 * numerator + denominator, 2 * denominator)

int half_away(int numerator, int denominator)
    result := (2 * math.abs(numerator) + denominator) / (2 * denominator)
    return if numerator < 0 then -result else result

string decimal_text(int value, string negative)
    absolute := math.abs(value)
    return (if value < 0 then negative else "") + string(absolute / 10) + "." + string(absolute % 10)

string index_text(int value)
    return if value == 1000000000000 then "none" else decimal_text(value, "+")

string handicap_text(int value)
    return if value == 1000000000000 then "none" elif value < 0 then "+" + string(-value) else string(value)

string hundredths(int value)
    return "{value / 100}.{value % 100:02.}"

string integer_list(int[] values)
    return [for value := values[] then string(value)].join(" ")

bool alphabetic_before(string a, string b)
    int[] aa := a.codepoints()
    int[] bb := b.codepoints()
    for: 0 <= k < math.min(int(#aa), int(#bb))
        if aa[k] != bb[k]
            return aa[k] < bb[k]
    return #aa < #bb

class Rank(int index, int[] keys, string id)

bool rank_before(const Rank a, const Rank b)
    for: 0 <= k < int(#a.keys)
        if a.keys[k] != b.keys[k]
            return a.keys[k] < b.keys[k]
    return alphabetic_before(a.id, b.id)

int[] ranked(Rank[] entries)
    for: 1 <= k < int(#entries)
        item := entries[k]
        position := k
        while position > 0 and rank_before(item, entries[position - 1])
            entries[position] = entries[position - 1]
            position -= 1
        entries[position] = item
    return [for item := entries[] then item.index]

class Course(string id, int[] pars, int[] si, int par)
class Tee(int course, string id, int rating, int slope)
class Calculation(int k, int average, int adjustment, int low, bool hard, bool soft, bool capped)
class Player(string id, string name, int index, int[] rounds, int[] record_days, int[] record_indexes, Calculation last)
class Round(int course, int tee, int day, int[] scores, int handicap, int[] adjusted, int ags, int differential, int exceptional, int prior_index, int prior_records, Calculation prior_last)
class Event(string id, string format, int course, int tee, int day, int allowance, int[] players)
class Evaluation(string reason, int[] rounds, int[] ph, int[][] nets, int[][] points, int[][] records, bool[] complete)
class MatchResult(string[] statuses, string result)
class State()
    Course[] courses := []
    Tee[] tees := []
    Player[] players := []
    Event[] events := []
    rounds := array(1000, fill = Round(0, 0, 0, [], 1000000000000, [], 0, 0, 0, 1000000000000, 0, Calculation(0, 0, 0, 1000000000000, false, false, false)))
    round_used := 0

void emit(string text)
    println(text)

void fail(string reason)
    emit("ERROR " + reason)

int course_id(const State state, string text)
    for: 0 <= k < int(#state.courses)
        if state.courses[k].id == text
            return k
    return -1

int tee_id(const State state, int course, string text)
    for: 0 <= k < int(#state.tees)
        if state.tees[k].course == course and state.tees[k].id == text
            return k
    return -1

int player_id(const State state, string text)
    for: 0 <= k < int(#state.players)
        if state.players[k].id == text
            return k
    return -1

int event_id(const State state, string text)
    for: 0 <= k < int(#state.events)
        if state.events[k].id == text
            return k
    return -1

int course_handicap(const State state, int course, int tee, int index)
    return half_up(index * state.tees[tee].slope + 113 * (state.tees[tee].rating - 10 * state.courses[course].par), 1130)

int[] allocation(const Course course, int handicap)
    absolute := math.abs(handicap)
    quotient := absolute / 18
    remainder := absolute % 18
    return [for k := (0:<18)[] then
        if handicap >= 0 then quotient + (if course.si[k] <= remainder then 1 else 0)
        else -quotient - (if course.si[k] >= 19 - remainder then 1 else 0)]

int[] low_record(const Player player, int day)
    value := 1000000000000
    date := 0
    for: 0 <= k < int(#player.record_days)
        candidate_day := player.record_days[k]
        candidate := player.record_indexes[k]
        if day - 365 <= candidate_day < day and (candidate < value or (candidate == value and candidate_day < date))
            value = candidate
            date = candidate_day
    return [value, date]

int[] count_rule(int count)
    if count == 3
        return [1, -20]
    if count == 4
        return [1, -10]
    if count == 5
        return [1, 0]
    if count == 6
        return [2, -10]
    if count <= 8
        return [2, 0]
    if count <= 11
        return [3, 0]
    if count <= 14
        return [4, 0]
    if count <= 16
        return [5, 0]
    if count <= 18
        return [6, 0]
    return [if count == 19 then 7 else 8, 0]

int[] adjusted_differentials(const State state, int person)
    ids := state.players[person].rounds
    first := math.max(0, int(#ids) - 20)
    result := array(nat(int(#ids) - first), fill = 0)
    reduction := 0
    position := int(#ids) - 1
    while position >= first
        item := state.rounds[ids[position]]
        reduction += item.exceptional
        result[position - first] = item.differential - reduction
        position -= 1
    return result

int[] counting_order(int[] adjusted)
    return ranked([for k := (0:<int(#adjusted))[] then Rank(k, [adjusted[k], -k], "")])

void update_index(State &state, int person, int day)
    adjusted := adjusted_differentials(state, person)
    count := int(#adjusted)
    if count < 3
        state.players[person].last = Calculation(0, 0, 0, 1000000000000, false, false, false)
        return
    rules := count_rule(count)
    order := counting_order(adjusted)
    int total := adjusted[order[:<rules[0]]].sum()
    average := half_away(total, rules[0])
    candidate := average + rules[1]
    low := low_record(state.players[person], day)
    soft := false
    hard := false
    if low[0] != 1000000000000
        if candidate - low[0] > 30
            candidate = low[0] + 30 + (candidate - low[0] - 30) / 2
            soft = true
        if candidate - low[0] > 50
            candidate = low[0] + 50
            hard = true
    capped := candidate > 540
    candidate = math.min(candidate, 540)
    state.players[person].index = candidate
    state.players[person].last = Calculation(rules[0], average, rules[1], low[0], hard, soft, capped)

int[] countback_keys(int[] values, bool higher)
    sign := if higher then -1 else 1
    return [sign * values.sum(), sign * values[9:].sum(), sign * values[12:].sum(), sign * values[15:].sum(), sign * values[17]]

Evaluation evaluate(const State state, const Event event)
    result := Evaluation("", [], [], [], [], [], [])
    for person := event.players[]
        selected := -1
        for index := state.players[person].rounds[]
            item := state.rounds[index]
            if item.course == event.course and item.tee == event.tee and item.day == event.day
                selected = index
                break
        if selected < 0
            result.reason = "missing round"
            return result
        if state.rounds[selected].handicap == 1000000000000
            result.reason = "no index"
            return result
        result.rounds = result.rounds.append(selected)
        result.ph = result.ph.append(half_up(state.rounds[selected].handicap * event.allowance, 100))
    lowest := result.ph.min()
    relative := event.format == "MATCH" or event.format == "NASSAU" or event.format == "FOURBALL"
    for: 0 <= k < int(#event.players)
        item := state.rounds[result.rounds[k]]
        strokes := allocation(state.courses[event.course], result.ph[k] - (if relative then lowest else 0))
        nets := array(18, fill = 1000000000000)
        points := array(18, fill = 0)
        records := array(18, fill = -1)
        complete := true
        for: 0 <= hole < 18
            if item.scores[hole] > 0
                nets[hole] = item.scores[hole] - strokes[hole]
                points[hole] = math.max(0, state.courses[event.course].pars[hole] + 2 - nets[hole])
                records[hole] = if nets[hole] < state.courses[event.course].pars[hole] then 1 elif nets[hole] == state.courses[event.course].pars[hole] then 0 else -1
            else
                complete = false
        result.nets = result.nets.append(nets)
        result.points = result.points.append(points)
        result.records = result.records.append(records)
        result.complete = result.complete.append(complete)
    return result

int[] individual_ranking(const State state, const Event event, const Evaluation result, gross := false)
    Rank[] entries := []
    for: 0 <= k < int(#event.players)
        if event.format == "STROKE" and not result.complete[k]
            continue
        values := if gross then state.rounds[result.rounds[k]].scores elif event.format == "STROKE" then result.nets[k] elif event.format == "STABLEFORD" then result.points[k] else result.records[k]
        entries = entries.append(Rank(k, countback_keys(values, event.format != "STROKE"), state.players[event.players[k]].id))
    return ranked(entries)

string match_status(int lead)
    return if lead == 0 then "AS" elif lead > 0 then string(lead) + " UP" else string(-lead) + " DN"

MatchResult play_match(int[] outcomes, int first, int last, string side_one, string side_two)
    lead := 0
    string[] statuses := []
    remaining := last - first
    for: first <= hole <= last
        lead += outcomes[hole]
        remaining = last - hole
        statuses = statuses.append(match_status(lead))
        if math.abs(lead) > remaining
            break
    text := "AS"
    if lead != 0
        text = (if lead > 0 then side_one else side_two) + " " + string(math.abs(lead)) + (if remaining > 0 then "&" + string(remaining) else " UP")
    return MatchResult(statuses, text)

void event_results(const State state, const Event event, const Evaluation result)
    emit("results " + event.id + ": " + event.format + " " + state.courses[event.course].id + " " + state.tees[event.tee].id + " day " + string(event.day) + " allowance " + string(event.allowance))
    count := int(#event.players)
    if event.format == "STROKE" or event.format == "STABLEFORD" or event.format == "PAR"
        order := individual_ranking(state, event, result)
        for: 0 <= k < int(#order)
            position := order[k]
            text := string(k + 1) + " " + state.players[event.players[position]].id
            if event.format == "STROKE"
                text += " net " + string(result.nets[position].sum()) + " gross " + string(state.rounds[result.rounds[position]].scores.sum())
            elif event.format == "STABLEFORD"
                text += " points " + string(result.points[position].sum())
            else
                text += " " + match_status(result.records[position].sum())
            emit(text + " hcp " + handicap_text(result.ph[position]))
        if event.format == "STROKE"
            Rank[] incomplete := []
            for: 0 <= k < count
                if not result.complete[k]
                    incomplete = incomplete.append(Rank(k, [], state.players[event.players[k]].id))
            for position := ranked(incomplete)[]
                emit("NR " + state.players[event.players[position]].id + " hcp " + handicap_text(result.ph[position]))
            if #order > 0
                winner := individual_ranking(state, event, result, true)[0]
                emit("gross " + state.players[event.players[winner]].id + " " + string(state.rounds[result.rounds[winner]].scores.sum()))
    elif event.format == "MATCH" or event.format == "NASSAU" or event.format == "FOURBALL"
        lowest := result.ph.min()
        text := "strokes"
        for: 0 <= k < count
            text += " " + state.players[event.players[k]].id + " " + string(result.ph[k] - lowest)
        emit(text)
        split := if event.format == "FOURBALL" then 2 else 1
        string[] sides := []
        int[][] side_scores := []
        for: 0 <= side < 2
            string[] names := []
            scores := array(18, fill = 1000000000000)
            for: side * split <= k < (side + 1) * split
                names = names.append(state.players[event.players[k]].id)
                for: 0 <= hole < 18
                    scores[hole] = math.min(scores[hole], result.nets[k][hole])
            sides = sides.append(names.join("+"))
            side_scores = side_scores.append(scores)
        outcomes := array(18, fill = 0)
        for: 0 <= hole < 18
            outcomes[hole] = if side_scores[0][hole] < side_scores[1][hole] then 1 elif side_scores[0][hole] > side_scores[1][hole] then -1 else 0
        if event.format == "NASSAU"
            emit("front " + play_match(outcomes, 0, 8, sides[0], sides[1]).result)
            emit("back " + play_match(outcomes, 9, 17, sides[0], sides[1]).result)
            emit("total " + play_match(outcomes, 0, 17, sides[0], sides[1]).result)
        else
            match_result := play_match(outcomes, 0, 17, sides[0], sides[1])
            emit("status " + match_result.statuses.join(", "))
            emit("result " + match_result.result)
    elif event.format == "BETTERBALL"
        Rank[] entries := []
        int[][] team_points := []
        for: 0 <= team < count / 2
            points := array(18, fill = 0)
            for: 0 <= hole < 18
                points[hole] = math.max(result.points[2 * team][hole], result.points[2 * team + 1][hole])
            team_points = team_points.append(points)
            entries = entries.append(Rank(team, countback_keys(points, true), state.players[event.players[2 * team]].id))
        order := ranked(entries)
        for: 0 <= k < int(#order)
            team := order[k]
            emit(string(k + 1) + " " + state.players[event.players[2 * team]].id + "+" + state.players[event.players[2 * team + 1]].id + " points " + string(team_points[team].sum()) + " hcp " + handicap_text(result.ph[2 * team]) + " " + handicap_text(result.ph[2 * team + 1]))
    else
        carry := 0
        totals := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
        int[] final_ties := []
        for: 0 <= hole < 18
            carry += 1
            best := 1000000000000
            int[] ties := []
            for: 0 <= k < count
                value := result.nets[k][hole]
                if value < best
                    best = value
                    ties = [k]
                elif value == best and value != 1000000000000
                    ties = ties.append(k)
            if #ties == 1
                winner := ties[0]
                totals[winner] += 100 * carry
                emit("hole " + string(hole + 1) + " " + state.players[event.players[winner]].id + " " + string(carry))
                carry = 0
            final_ties = ties
        if carry > 0
            if #final_ties == 0
                final_ties = 0:<count
            Rank[] entries := []
            for position := final_ties[]
                entries = entries.append(Rank(position, [], state.players[event.players[position]].id))
            text := "carry " + string(carry)
            share := carry * 100 / int(#final_ties)
            for position := ranked(entries)[]
                totals[position] += share
                text += " " + state.players[event.players[position]].id
            emit(text)
        Rank[] entries := []
        for: 0 <= k < count
            entries = entries.append(Rank(k, [-totals[k]], state.players[event.players[k]].id))
        for position := ranked(entries)[]
            emit(state.players[event.players[position]].id + " " + hundredths(totals[position]))

void card_totals(const Course course, const Round item, int[] strokes, string label, int first, int last)
    score := 0
    net := 0
    points := 0
    complete := true
    for: first <= hole < last
        if item.scores[hole] > 0
            score += item.scores[hole]
            net += item.scores[hole] - strokes[hole]
            points += math.max(0, course.pars[hole] + 2 - item.scores[hole] + strokes[hole])
        else
            complete = false
    emit(label + " " + string(course.pars[first:<last].sum()) + " " + (if complete then string(score) else "-") + " " + string(item.adjusted[first:<last].sum()) + " " + string(strokes[first:<last].sum()) + " " + (if complete then string(net) else "-") + " " + string(points))

void player_statistics(const State state, int person)
    categories := array(7, fill = 0)
    sums := array(3, fill = 0)
    counts := array(3, fill = 0)
    complete_count := 0
    complete_total := 0
    best := 1000000000000
    for index := state.players[person].rounds[]
        item := state.rounds[index]
        course := state.courses[item.course]
        complete := true
        total := 0
        for: 0 <= hole < 18
            score := item.scores[hole]
            if score <= 0
                complete = false
                if score == 0
                    categories[6] += 1
            else
                difference := score - course.pars[hole]
                category := if difference <= -2 then 0 elif difference == -1 then 1 elif difference == 0 then 2 elif difference == 1 then 3 elif difference == 2 then 4 else 5
                categories[category] += 1
                par := course.pars[hole] - 3
                sums[par] += score
                counts[par] += 1
                total += score
        if complete
            complete_count += 1
            complete_total += total
            best = math.min(best, total)
    text := "stats " + state.players[person].id + ": rounds " + string(#state.players[person].rounds) + " best " + (if complete_count == 0 then "-" else string(best)) + " average " + (if complete_count == 0 then "-" else hundredths(complete_total * 100 / complete_count))
    names := ["eagles", "birdies", "pars", "bogeys", "doubles", "others", "pickups"]
    for: 0 <= k < 7
        text += " " + names[k] + " " + string(categories[k])
    for: 0 <= k < 3
        text += " par" + string(k + 3) + " " + (if counts[k] == 0 then "-" else hundredths(sums[k] * 100 / counts[k]))
    emit(text)

void hole_statistics(const State state, int course_index)
    course := state.courses[course_index]
    considered := 0
    sums := array(18, fill = 0)
    counts := array(18, fill = 0)
    for player := state.players[]
        for index := player.rounds[]
            item := state.rounds[index]
            if item.course == course_index
                considered += 1
                for: 0 <= hole < 18
                    if item.scores[hole] > 0
                        sums[hole] += item.scores[hole]
                        counts[hole] += 1
    order := 0:<18
    for: 1 <= k < 18
        hole := order[k]
        position := k
        while position > 0
            previous := order[position - 1]
            earlier := counts[hole] > 0 and (counts[previous] == 0 or (sums[hole] - course.pars[hole] * counts[hole]) * counts[previous] > (sums[previous] - course.pars[previous] * counts[previous]) * counts[hole])
            if not earlier
                break
            order[position] = previous
            position -= 1
        order[position] = hole
    ranks := array(18, fill = 0)
    for: 0 <= k < 18
        ranks[order[k]] = k + 1
    emit("holestats " + course.id + ": rounds " + string(considered))
    for: 0 <= hole < 18
        emit(string(hole + 1) + " par " + string(course.pars[hole]) + " si " + string(course.si[hole]) + " scores " + string(counts[hole]) + " avg " + (if counts[hole] == 0 then "-" else hundredths(sums[hole] * 100 / counts[hole])) + " rank " + string(ranks[hole]))

void merit(const State state)
    count := int(#state.players)
    points := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    wins := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    appearances := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    counted := 0
    awards := [10, 8, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1]
    for event := state.events[]
        if event.format != "STROKE" and event.format != "STABLEFORD" and event.format != "PAR"
            continue
        result := evaluate(state, event)
        if result.reason != ""
            continue
        counted += 1
        for person := event.players[]
            appearances[person] += 1
        order := individual_ranking(state, event, result)
        for: 0 <= k < int(#order)
            person := event.players[order[k]]
            points[person] += awards[k]
            if k == 0
                wins[person] += 1
    Rank[] entries := []
    for: 0 <= k < count
        if appearances[k] > 0
            entries = entries.append(Rank(k, [-points[k], -wins[k]], state.players[k].id))
    emit("merit: events " + string(counted))
    order := ranked(entries)
    for: 0 <= k < int(#order)
        person := order[k]
        emit(string(k + 1) + " " + state.players[person].id + " " + string(points[person]) + " wins " + string(wins[person]) + " played " + string(appearances[person]))

void command(State &state, string line)
    words := line.split(" ")
    action := words[0]
    if action == "COURSE"
        if course_id(state, words[1]) >= 0
            fail("duplicate course")
            return
        int[] pars := []
        int[] si := []
        valid := true
        par := 0
        for: 0 <= k < 18
            value := integer_value(words[k + 2])
            if value < 3 or value > 5
                valid = false
            pars = pars.append(value)
            par += value
            si = si.append(integer_value(words[k + 20]))
        for: 1 <= target <= 18
            found := 0
            for value := si[]
                if value == target
                    found += 1
            if found != 1
                valid = false
        if not valid
            fail("invalid course")
        else
            state.courses = state.courses.append(Course(words[1], pars, si, par))
        return
    if action == "TEE" or action == "HCPTABLE" or action == "HOLESTATS"
        course := course_id(state, words[1])
        if course < 0
            fail("unknown course")
            return
        if action == "HOLESTATS"
            hole_statistics(state, course)
            return
        tee := tee_id(state, course, words[2])
        if action == "TEE"
            if tee >= 0
                fail("duplicate tee")
                return
            rating := integer_value(words[3])
            slope := integer_value(words[4])
            if rating < 500 or rating > 900 or slope < 55 or slope > 155
                fail("invalid tee")
            else
                state.tees = state.tees.append(Tee(course, words[2], rating, slope))
        else
            if tee < 0
                fail("unknown tee")
                return
            first := integer_value(words[3])
            last := integer_value(words[4])
            if not (-100 <= first <= last <= 540)
                fail("invalid index")
                return
            emit("hcptable " + words[1] + " " + words[2] + ": " + index_text(first) + " to " + index_text(last))
            start := first
            handicap := course_handicap(state, course, tee, first)
            for: first + 1 <= value <= last + 1
                next_handicap := if value <= last then course_handicap(state, course, tee, value) else handicap + 1
                if next_handicap != handicap
                    emit(index_text(start) + " to " + index_text(value - 1) + ": " + handicap_text(handicap))
                    start = value
                    handicap = next_handicap
        return
    if action == "PLAYER"
        if player_id(state, words[1]) >= 0
            fail("duplicate player")
            return
        index := if #words == 4 then integer_value(words[3]) else 1000000000000
        if index != 1000000000000 and (index < -100 or index > 540)
            fail("invalid index")
        else
            state.players = state.players.append(Player(words[1], words[2], index, [], [], [], Calculation(0, 0, 0, 1000000000000, false, false, false)))
        return
    if action == "EVENT"
        if event_id(state, words[1]) >= 0
            fail("duplicate event")
            return
        course := course_id(state, words[3])
        tee := tee_id(state, course, words[4])
        if course < 0
            fail("unknown course")
            return
        if tee < 0
            fail("unknown tee")
            return
        allowance := integer_value(words[6])
        if allowance < 1 or allowance > 100
            fail("invalid allowance")
            return
        int[] people := []
        duplicate := false
        for: 7 <= k < int(#words)
            person := player_id(state, words[k])
            if person < 0
                fail("unknown player")
                return
            for previous := people[]
                if previous == person
                    duplicate = true
            people = people.append(person)
        count := int(#people)
        format := words[2]
        valid := if format == "MATCH" or format == "NASSAU" then count == 2 elif format == "FOURBALL" then count == 4 elif format == "BETTERBALL" then count == 4 or count == 6 or count == 8 else 2 <= count <= 8
        if duplicate or not valid
            fail("invalid players")
        else
            state.events = state.events.append(Event(words[1], format, course, tee, integer_value(words[5]), allowance, people))
        return
    if action == "RESULTS"
        event_index := event_id(state, words[1])
        if event_index < 0
            fail("unknown event")
        else
            result := evaluate(state, state.events[event_index])
            if result.reason != ""
                fail(result.reason)
            else
                event_results(state, state.events[event_index], result)
        return
    if action == "MERIT"
        merit(state)
        return
    if action == "PLAYERS"
        Rank[] entries := []
        for: 0 <= k < int(#state.players)
            entries = entries.append(Rank(k, [state.players[k].index], state.players[k].id))
        emit("players " + string(#state.players))
        for person := ranked(entries)[]
            item := state.players[person]
            emit(item.id + " " + item.name + " " + index_text(item.index) + " rounds " + string(#item.rounds))
        return
    person := player_id(state, words[1])
    if person < 0
        fail("unknown player")
        return
    id := state.players[person].id
    count := int(#state.players[person].rounds)
    if action == "ROUND" or action == "COURSEHCP"
        course := course_id(state, words[2])
        tee := tee_id(state, course, words[3])
        if course < 0
            fail("unknown course")
            return
        if tee < 0
            fail("unknown tee")
            return
        index := state.players[person].index
        if action == "COURSEHCP"
            if index == 1000000000000
                fail("no index")
            else
                handicap := course_handicap(state, course, tee, index)
                emit("coursehcp " + id + " " + words[2] + " " + words[3] + ": " + handicap_text(handicap) + " strokes " + integer_list(allocation(state.courses[course], handicap)))
            return
        day := integer_value(words[4])
        if count > 0 and day < state.rounds[state.players[person].rounds[count - 1]].day
            fail("invalid day")
            return
        int[] scores := []
        missing := 0
        for: 0 <= hole < 18
            text := words[hole + 5]
            score := if text == "X" then 0 elif text == "-" then -1 else integer_value(text)
            if score == -1
                missing += 1
            scores = scores.append(score)
        if missing >= 5
            fail("too few holes")
            return
        handicap := if index == 1000000000000 then 1000000000000 else course_handicap(state, course, tee, index)
        strokes := allocation(state.courses[course], if handicap == 1000000000000 then 0 else handicap)
        adjusted := array(18, fill = 0)
        for: 0 <= hole < 18
            par := state.courses[course].pars[hole]
            limit := if index == 1000000000000 then par + 5 else par + 2 + strokes[hole]
            adjusted[hole] = if scores[hole] > 0 then math.min(scores[hole], limit) elif scores[hole] == 0 then limit else par + strokes[hole]
        ags := adjusted.sum()
        differential := half_away(113 * (10 * ags - state.tees[tee].rating), state.tees[tee].slope)
        exceptional := if index == 1000000000000 or index - differential < 70 then 0 elif index - differential < 100 then 10 else 20
        round_index := state.round_used
        state.round_used += 1
        state.rounds[round_index] = Round(course, tee, day, scores, handicap, adjusted, ags, differential, exceptional, index, int(#state.players[person].record_days), state.players[person].last)
        state.players[person].rounds = state.players[person].rounds.append(round_index)
        update_index(&state, person, day)
        updated := state.players[person].index
        if updated != 1000000000000
            state.players[person].record_days = state.players[person].record_days.append(day)
            state.players[person].record_indexes = state.players[person].record_indexes.append(updated)
        emit("round " + id + " " + string(count + 1) + ": ags " + string(ags) + " diff " + decimal_text(differential, "-") + (if exceptional > 0 then " exceptional " + decimal_text(-exceptional, "-") else "") + " index " + index_text(updated))
    elif action == "REMOVE"
        if count == 0
            fail("no rounds")
        else
            item := state.rounds[state.players[person].rounds[count - 1]]
            state.players[person].rounds = state.players[person].rounds[:<count - 1]
            state.players[person].index = item.prior_index
            state.players[person].record_days = state.players[person].record_days[:<item.prior_records]
            state.players[person].record_indexes = state.players[person].record_indexes[:<item.prior_records]
            state.players[person].last = item.prior_last
            emit("removed " + id + " " + string(count) + ": index " + index_text(item.prior_index))
    elif action == "INDEX"
        item := state.players[person]
        text := "index " + id + ": " + index_text(item.index) + " rounds " + string(count)
        calculation := item.last
        if calculation.k > 0
            text += " lowest " + string(calculation.k) + " average " + decimal_text(calculation.average, "-") + " adjustment " + decimal_text(calculation.adjustment, "-")
            if calculation.low != 1000000000000
                text += " low " + index_text(calculation.low)
            if calculation.hard
                text += " hard cap"
            elif calculation.soft
                text += " soft cap"
            if calculation.capped
                text += " maximum"
        emit(text)
    elif action == "LOWINDEX"
        day := integer_value(words[2])
        low := low_record(state.players[person], day)
        emit("lowindex " + id + " " + string(day) + ": " + index_text(low[0]) + (if low[0] == 1000000000000 then "" else " day " + string(low[1])))
    elif action == "HISTORY"
        emit("history " + id + ": rounds " + string(count))
        adjusted := adjusted_differentials(state, person)
        order := counting_order(adjusted)
        used := if #adjusted < 3 then 0 else count_rule(int(#adjusted))[0]
        first := math.max(0, count - 20)
        for: 0 <= k < int(#adjusted)
            item := state.rounds[state.players[person].rounds[first + k]]
            counting := false
            for: 0 <= j < used
                if order[j] == k
                    counting = true
            emit(string(first + k + 1) + " day " + string(item.day) + " " + state.courses[item.course].id + " " + state.tees[item.tee].id + " ags " + string(item.ags) + " diff " + decimal_text(item.differential, "-") + (if adjusted[k] != item.differential then " adjusted " + decimal_text(adjusted[k], "-") else "") + (if counting then " *" else ""))
    elif action == "STATS"
        player_statistics(state, person)
    else
        number := integer_value(words[2])
        if number > count
            fail("unknown round")
            return
        item := state.rounds[state.players[person].rounds[number - 1]]
        course := state.courses[item.course]
        strokes := allocation(course, if item.handicap == 1000000000000 then 0 else item.handicap)
        emit("card " + id + " " + string(number) + ": " + course.id + " " + state.tees[item.tee].id + " day " + string(item.day) + " handicap " + handicap_text(item.handicap))
        for: 0 <= hole < 18
            score := item.scores[hole]
            raw := if score > 0 then string(score) elif score == 0 then "X" else "-"
            net := if score > 0 then string(score - strokes[hole]) else "-"
            points := if score > 0 then math.max(0, course.pars[hole] + 2 - score + strokes[hole]) else 0
            emit(string(hole + 1) + " " + string(course.pars[hole]) + " " + string(course.si[hole]) + " " + raw + " " + string(item.adjusted[hole]) + " " + string(strokes[hole]) + " " + net + " " + string(points))
            if hole == 8
                card_totals(course, item, strokes, "OUT", 0, 9)
            elif hole == 17
                card_totals(course, item, strokes, "IN", 9, 18)
                card_totals(course, item, strokes, "TOTAL", 0, 18)
        emit("ags " + string(item.ags) + " diff " + decimal_text(item.differential, "-"))

command_count := 0
scan(&command_count)
golf := State()
for: 0 <= line_number < command_count
    input_line := ""
    scan(&input_line)
    command(&golf, input_line)
